name: public_solver_distillation_free_threehead
hypothesis: Learn geometry from a stronger public-input solver offline so unchanged small F85 supplies a three-step repair with more feasible shape/order and fewer low-quality row fallbacks.
model: three small F85 message heads241547 trainable parameters, frozen E74; first two center/log-aspect proposals are linear residuals scaled0.5 without tanh trust cap or frozen-L frame. Canonical public locks/nonnegative/ratio[-5,5], MIB coherence in current proposal frame, third bounded local polish plus original8step geometry in current proposal frame.
initialization: frozen E74 and compatible F85 hidden/message weights copied; all three final output layers zeroed; fresh AdamW seed0. Initial function is geometry-only residual-zero control, not old F85.
data: v5 frozen first16000 train and same dev_monitor500; train_monitor500 reuse train labels; source has inherited32k exposure

teacher.method: one original full E85 repair per frozen F85 public draft, original adaptive controls/robust fallback/certified rigid polish; offline only
teacher.inputs: public specs/connectivity/current frozen NN draft only, no free reference geometry or official score denominators
teacher.labels: center/log-aspect of final public-solver geometry; stored only as supervision, never network input
teacher.usable: strict public hard-legal, finite, not row_control fallback; all members retained, fallback labels carry zero imitation weight
teacher.panel: train16000+dev_monitor500 only; no full dev2000 or test teacher generation

loss.center: SmoothL1(beta0.1), center errors normalized by sqrt(public area), public free-variable mask
loss.shape: squared log(w/h) difference on free shapes
loss.relative: SmoothL1(beta0.1) normalized pair center difference; teacher near pairs within0.25 mean local scale, at least one free center
loss.scope: fixed public-solver imitation task, no true reference target or B/A coefficient sweep; initial control tests amortization, not proof of Q optimum
loss.monitoring: same per-case total for backward/train500/dev500/best/LR/early-stop, mean over all frozen panel members; zero-weight cases included and counted

engine: source cached frozen L drafts; CUDA graph for F+same Loss+backward+clip, guarded AdamW outside; graph/real update/resume checked on five train members before formal start
terminal: unique own-Loss best: one fixed dev500 true batch1 GPU+same slim3 full request evaluation and same100 four-stage gallery; full dev2000 raw diagnostics if budget permits; no Q checkpoint reselection
caveats: This tests removing catastrophic weak-repair fallback, not proof of Q<1.01.
Removing fixed source frame increases freedom; teacher imitation supplies compact geometry guidance, and final slim3 hard check remains mandatory.
9 train targets exceed decoder aspect range; nominal-area and MIB projection can prevent exact imitation. All errors retained and reported.
training_start_gate: teacher panel coverage and identity verified, same5 update/resume/numerical checks passed; trainer not yet authorized to skip registration
